mostWorthwhile.text: Closing the surface was most worthwhile: the new cells visibly spanned the gap, while the deeper tissue still needed work.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the supporting fibres and then fitting them felt a little repetitive, although the separate pictures showed why both steps mattered.

surprise.text: I was surprised that wound messengers could prompt a nearby capillary to grow a branch; the picture made its connection to blood supply clearer, though not exactly how the signal works.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although I followed the named messenger pairing without understanding its detailed mechanism.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing the surface, support and blood supply come together made the repair understandable, even if some fitting steps felt repetitive.
